summary: Enhance your skills in food security and nutrition during emergencies. Join our training to learn effective strategies and best practices for crisis situations.
lede: Emergency food security and nutrition training helps humanitarian professionals assess needs and plan support during crises. It covers rapid assessments and mobile data collection, interpretation of acute malnutrition indicators, and the design of food assistance and community-based malnutrition programs for professionals responsible for implementing or monitoring emergency interventions.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for designing, implementing, or monitoring humanitarian interventions in crisis-affected regions.
modules: Foundations of Emergency Food Security and Nutrition
Rapid Assessment and Digital Data Collection
Logistics and Specialized Nutritious Food Management
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of humanitarian principles. No prior coding knowledge is required, though familiarity with Excel is recommended for data exercises. Laptops are required for digital assessment workshops.
